# spydersoftidentity_role (Resource)

A role that users can be assigned to, with the claims every member receives. Import with the role name. Assigning users to roles is not managed by this resource.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "spydersoftidentity_role" "editor" {
  name = "editor"

  # Claims every member of the role receives. A type may repeat with different
  # values; the value defaults to an empty string. Types must not contain "/".
  claims = [
    { type = "permission", value = "articles.read" },
    { type = "permission", value = "articles.write" },
    { type = "urn:example:department", value = "content" },
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Role name. Unique, ignoring case. Renaming keeps the role id and its members.

### Optional

- `claims` (Attributes Set) Claims granted to every member of the role. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--claims))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Numeric identifier assigned by the server.

<a id="nestedatt--claims"></a>
### Nested Schema for `claims`

Required:

- `type` (String) Claim type. Must not contain "/".

Optional:

- `value` (String) Claim value. Defaults to an empty string.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by role name.
terraform import spydersoftidentity_role.editor editor
```
